Graph-level node queries

Source: R/construction.R
graph-queries.Rd

nodes() returns all node names in alphabetical order. topological_sort() returns the nodes of a DAG in topological order: for every directed edge u --> v, u appears before v. exogenous_nodes() returns the nodes with no parents (for a UG, the isolated nodes).

Usage

nodes(cg)

topological_sort(cg)

exogenous_nodes(cg, undirected_as_parents = FALSE)

Arguments

cg

A graph created with cgraph(). Supported classes vary by function:

  • nodes(): any class.

  • topological_sort(): DAG.

  • exogenous_nodes(): any class except PAG.

undirected_as_parents

Only used for PDAG-family graphs. If TRUE, a node incident to any undirected edge is not considered exogenous.

Value

Character vector of node names.

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  dag <- cgraph(B %-->% A, A %-->% C)
  list(
    nodes = nodes(dag),
    topological_sort = topological_sort(dag),
    exogenous_nodes = exogenous_nodes(dag)
  )
}
#> $nodes
#> [1] "A" "B" "C"
#> 
#> $topological_sort
#> [1] "B" "A" "C"
#> 
#> $exogenous_nodes
#> [1] "B"
#> 

if (julia_ready()) {
  pdag <- cgraph(A %-->% B, B %---% C, class = "PDAG")
  list(
    exogenous_nodes = exogenous_nodes(pdag),
    exogenous_nodes_undirected_as_parents =
      exogenous_nodes(pdag, undirected_as_parents = TRUE)
  )
}
#> $exogenous_nodes
#> [1] "A" "C"
#> 
#> $exogenous_nodes_undirected_as_parents
#> [1] "A"
#>
